audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Vayne Levels 2 and 3 in both layers, while every prose line says the opposite — whys[1] calls Level 2 'your single biggest window' and early opens 'Levels 1-3 are yours'. Level 6 was also marked Skill while whys[4] and spikes[2] both describe The Culling executing her.
audit.why: Lucian's Level 2 Q + Lightslinger double-shot lands before Silver Bolts (W) can reach its third stack, and Vayne's only trade tools at that point are a 6s-cooldown Tumble and a 90-mana, 20s-at-rank-1 Condemn. She has no waveclear and no sustain to answer it.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 6 flipped to Lucian in both layers, ratings raised to match; Levels 4-5 stays Skill and First item / 2+ items stay Vayne.
sources: brief enemyKit (Vayne Q cd 6/5/4/3/2, E cd 20/18/16/14/12 cost 90)

audit.why: Spike timeline is accurate: Lucian peaks Levels 2-3 and again at first item, Vayne takes over on Blade of the Ruined King plus Runaan's, and Final Hour (100/85/70s) is her fight-winning cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Ardent Blaze (W) reveals — and the page never connects it to Final Hour, which grants Vayne invisibility during every Tumble.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Lucian's W says it marks and briefly reveals enemies, and Final Hour's text grants 'Invisibility during Tumble'. That is the single decisive post-6 interaction in this matchup and it was absent from the page.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names the reveal and the Final Hour tumble it answers.
sources: brief ownerKit W text + revealsStealth flag

audit.why: Tumble (Q) carries an auto-attack reset, so the tell is the attack wind-up rather than the cast — the existing early text already instructs saving the double-shot for after she tumbles, which covers the missing-interaction headline.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Vayne as 'he' and 'him' throughout, and early/mid write 'Silver Bolt' singular (flagged in packet defects).
audit.why: The ability is Silver Bolts; the wrong pronoun and wrong ability name are exactly the tells that make a page read as machine-written.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in the fields that carry them and the ability name pluralised.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours and you have to cash them in. At Level 2 your Q + Lightslinger double-tap chunks her before Silver Bolts is anywhere near three stacks, and she has no waveclear or trade tool that answers it. Use W to mark her, then weave the empowered shots and E in to stick — she will try to Q tumble to break line of sight, so save your double-shot for after she tumbles. Do not facecheck a stacked Silver Bolt trade for no reason; you win when you pick the timing, not her.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours and you have to cash them in. At Level 2 your Q + Lightslinger double-tap chunks her before Silver Bolts is anywhere near three stacks, and she has no waveclear or trade tool that answers it. Use W to mark her, then weave the empowered shots and E in to stick — Tumble is an attack reset, so the wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast. Do not facecheck a stacked Silver Bolts trade; you win when you pick the timing, not her.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 narrow as her tumble cooldown drops and your mana strains, so trade in bursts and reset rather than DPS-racing her — three Silver Bolt procs is real percent-HP damage even on your kited trades. At 6 The Culling is your hardest all-in, but it is a damage spike, not a free kill: channel it only when her Q tumble (invis) and E condemn are both down, otherwise she blinks out or walls you and you channel into nothing. Bait the condemn before you commit your dash.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 narrow as Tumble falls to a 2s cooldown at rank 5 and your mana strains, so trade in bursts rather than DPS-racing her — the third Silver Bolts hit is true damage your armour never touches. At 6 The Culling is your hardest all-in, but it is a damage spike, not a free kill: channel it only when Tumble and Condemn (16s at rank 3) are both down, or she tumbles out and you channel into nothing. Bait Condemn before you spend your dash.
